questions_and_answers.question_text: What is qián a short form of, and where may it be substituted?
What is the literal meaning of fàng xīn?
Why is suàn hard to translate?
Write the Chinese for "With you in charge, I am at ease."

answers.answer_text: Nǐ bàn shì, wǒ fàng xīn.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Being poor isn't a problem; it's being lazy that's a problem."

answers.answer_text: Qióng bú shi wèntí, lǎn cái shi wèntí.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "It's nothing! We're friends, after all!"
Write the Chinese for "I'll worry if you go alone."

answers.answer_text: Nǐ yíge rén qù, wǒ bú fàng xīn.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Would you say that Hángzhōu is an industrial city?"

answers.answer_text: Hángzhōu suàn bu suàn gōngyè chéngshì?

articles.text:
8. A: Tīngshuō èrshinián qián yǒu    I heard that twenty years ago a lot of
      hěn duō niánqīng rén dàole     young people came to that poor and
      nèige méiyou rénde qióng       unpopulated place.
      dìfang.
   B: Shì a! Kěshi xiànzài zhèngfǔ  Yes, but now the government need not
      kěyi fàng xīn le. Nèige        worry anymore. That place can be
      dìfang yǐjing suàn jiànshède   considered to have been pretty well
      bú cuò le.                     built up.

Notes on No. 8

èrshinián qián: QIÁN is a SHORT FORM of YǏQIÁN. You can often SUBSTITUTE qián for yǐqián when it comes at the END of a time phrase.

Wǒ lái Měiguó qián, shénme yě    Before I came to America, I didn't
méi zhǔnbèi.                     prepare anything.
Yíge yuè qián, zhèige dàlóu hái  A month ago, this building wasn't even
méi gàiwán, xiànzài yǐjing zhù   finished yet, and now there are already
rén le.                          people living in it.

qióng: "to be poor"

Qióng bú shi wèntí, lǎn cái shi  Being poor isn't a problem; it's being
wèntí.                           lazy that's a problem.

fàng xīn: "to be unworried," "to be at ease," "to put one's mind at ease" (literally, "PUT DOWN THE HEART")

Nǐ bàn shì, wǒ fàng xīn.         With you in charge, I am at ease.
Nǐ fàng xīn hǎo le, wǒ huì xiǎng Don't you worry. I'll think of a way.
bànfǎde.
Nǐ yíge rén qù, wǒ bú fàng xīn.  I'll worry if you go alone.

suàn: "to be COUNTED as," "to be CONSIDERED as," "can be REGARDED as." This verb is used MUCH MORE OFTEN than these English translations would seem to indicate. To really get the feel of what suàn means, you have to look at it IN CONTEXT:

A: Hángzhōu suàn bu suàn gōngyè  Would you say that Hángzhōu is an
   chéngshì?                     industrial city?
B: Bú suàn, suàn yóulǎn chéngshì. No, it's a tourist city.

Zhème duō cài, sānshikuài qián   Thirty dollars isn't expensive for so
bú suàn guì.                     much food.
Nǐ děi zìjǐ huì shuō nǐ xiǎngde  You have to be able to say what you want
dōngxi cái suàn huì shuō         to say before you can be considered to
Zhōngwén.                        speak Chinese.
A: Tài xièxie le!                Thank you so much!
B: Nà suàn shénme! Péngyou ma!   It's nothing! We're friends, after all!
Fāzhǎn bǐjiào kuàide yào suàn    One would have to say the coal industry
méitàn gōngyè hé jīxiè gōngyè.   and the machine industry are the most
                                 rapidly developing.
Zhèi yě suàn Běijīng kǎoyā ma?   They call this Peking duck? The flavor
Wèi bú duì ma!                   is all wrong!
